summary: Full backend + frontend test of the 5-phase Instant Delivery System (multi-warehouse CRUD, coverage check, ETA proxy, order persistence, Admin Warehouse UI, CheckoutMap + order flow). All 10 backend tests PASS. All frontend flows verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: warehouses.py uses payload.dict() (Pydantic v1 shim). Prefer .model_dump() for consistency with rest of codebase — minor.
Legacy migration in _ensure_migrated() inserts warehouse with lat/lng=None → coverage skips it silently (correct behaviour, just worth noting to admins).
CheckoutMap loads Google Maps SDK from browser using REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (this is unavoidable for the JS map). The coverage/reverse-geocode calls correctly go via backend proxy.
server.py file is large (3690 lines) — should be split into modules for maintainability (existing tech debt).
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted one warehouse ('TEST_WH_A') during backend CRUD test; created + deleted one warehouse ('TEST_UI_Warehouse') during admin UI test. One test order CG539026 was placed via UI (COD, ₹562, anti-aging-serum) to verify delivery fields persist — this order remains in the DB by design (order deletion is not part of the scope).
